name: adaptive-eval-verify-high-fixes
title: fix(eval): 复核两处高危——artifact ref 内容解析 + 第二批真实 schema 脱敏（票 5cm）
description: 第二轮独立复核（对 5cj/5ck 的验证）报了两处新高危与若干残留：1) 真实 checkpoint 的 copy_content/visual_plan 等已被 artifact_seam ref 化，抽取器只读 channel_values 会写出无内容 fixture——新增 --store-uri 打开 Artifact Store，用 resolve_state 解析；无 store 或解析不出的记录跳过并计 unresolved_artifacts，绝不静默写空内容；2) 真实 schema 仍有 platform_post_id/run_id/target_id/blogger_notes_meta.ids/confirmer/confirmed_by/user_viral_links 泄漏——补齐标识符与复数 url/link 规则、artifacts 映射丢弃、绝对路径覆盖 UNC/file://及 /data 等根。残留中危：manifest.sha256 改为必需（除非给 out-of-band 值）、gate 校验 extractor_version、policy 逐 phase 预算与更严类型、JudgeBudget 的 used 边界与 max_calls 只读、任何 live 运行（含 human 裁判）都需 XHS_EVAL_LIVE=1、phase 过滤不再因 seen 提前标记而丢线程、Postgres 驱动错误干净退出、文档如实同步。
creator: codex
notes: DONE 2026-11-02 (second, adversarial verification of the first fix round). HIGH 1: real checkpoints are artifact-ref'd — every node is wrapped by artifact_seam and refify_updates moves copy_content/visual_plan/draft_content/shooting_plan/trend_data/viral_posts into the Artifact Store, so an extractor that only read channel_values produced fixtures with no title/body for the E4 judge. The extractor now accepts --store-uri, resolves each ref via resolve_state, drops the artifacts mapping in redaction, and skips any record whose refs still lack bodies, counting unresolved_artifacts and printing a warning instead of writing a content-less fixture; tests cover the no-store skip and a real InMemoryStore+put_artifact resolution. HIGH 2: a second batch of real-schema identity fields still leaked — platform_post_id (a real note id that reconstructs a URL), run_id, engagement_actions[].target_id, blogger_notes_meta.ids, publish_confirmation.confirmer, publish_options.confirmed_by, inline user_viral_links, plural *_urls/*_links, UNC \\server paths, /data|/srv|/private roots and file:// URIs. They now map to post/run/target/id/user pseudonyms or blanking, the absolute-path regex covers UNC/file:// and more roots, and a regression seeds exactly these fields. Medium residuals fixed: manifest.sha256 is required unless an out-of-band --expect-manifest-sha256 is given (deleting it used to disable edit detection); the gate now compares extractor_version; describe() samples context_budgets for every WorkflowPhase so a phase-only variant appears in the diff and invalid per-phase budgets are red; check_policy rejects blank escalation targets, blank capabilities and negative concurrency; JudgeBudget validates 0<=used<=max_calls, refuses negative counters and makes max_calls read-only after construction; XHS_EVAL_LIVE is required for every live plan (a human judge still spends workflow calls); the report labels estimated_total_calls as an estimate, not a runtime cap; select_corpus no longer marks a thread seen before the phase filter, so a thread whose newest checkpoint is in another phase can still contribute its newest in-phase checkpoint; psycopg/asyncpg/aiosqlite driver errors now exit 1 cleanly instead of tracebacking. Docs and runbook updated accordingly (extractor/redaction versions bumped to 3, 29 gate tests, per-phase budgets, arming rule, --store-uri step). Verification: targeted suites green, unit/scripts+harness, ruff, mypy, full suite in the journal.
